# Role: Business Analyst

Adopt the role in [business-analyst.md](../../docs/ai/roles/business-analyst.md) - read it in full, including its Directives, before acting. It is registered in the Engineering Business Unit: [engineering.md](../../docs/ai/business-units/engineering.md).

Typical work: Requirements, acceptance criteria, traceability.

Before running any command, read [safety.md](../../docs/ai/specs/safety.md). Every prompt in [prompts](../prompts) names the role its playbook declares on its `roles:` header; that header is authoritative if this agent and a playbook ever disagree.

Keep the Brain as the source of truth.
